messages:
Ava: Heads up — enabled strict structured validation on /invoke-tool canary (route id: tool-invoke-v3). Seeing ~1.1% fncall output rejections. Need a pragmatic sampling plan for manual triage. :eyes:

Ava: Example from logs:
```
[WARN] validator=structured_output reject reason=type_mismatch expected=object got=array payload_id=ps-9a3b
{"tool":"search","result":["item1","item2"]}
```

Ravi: Do we have a timeseries (rejects / minute)? Is this a new spike after the schema bump or steady? What's canary traffic share?

Ava: Canary is 5% traffic. Spike started right after the json_schema update rolled at 11:05 PT. Attaching a raw failure sample below for triage: 
```
expected: {"name": "string", "args": {"query":"string"}}
actual:   {"name": "search", "args": ["pizza","near:94107"]}
```

Sam: Looks like a lot of adapters return arrays for multi-hit results. Two approaches: loosen the schema to accept arrays OR keep strict validation and surface failures. I lean strict + sample so we can fix adapters rather than silently coerce.

Kai: For sampling we should: record 100% of validation rejects to an internal topic but persist only a bounded sample (eg 10% or first N per minute) to S3 for human review. Console should show a Rejected Samples card with rate + permalink to example. Also tag telemetry with route.rollout_phase=canary.

Marta: Agree. Also include a boolean field fallback_used in the event so Console can quickly show whether the request used fallback model/route. Retention: keep full payloads for 7 days, metadata for 30 days. PII must be redacted before storage.

deploy-bot: deploy-tool-invoke-v3 canary -> success (5% traffic). :white_check_mark:

Ava: Can we surface a tiny inline preview in Console (no infra click-through)? I want id, short diff, and a permalink to full sample.

Kai: Yep. Proposed flow: sampling service emits sample_id + short_diff + metadata to ClickHouse. Full sample (redacted) goes to S3 with sample_id. Console fetches metadata + preview endpoint. UX will show one-line diff and a "view sample" link. :+1:

Ravi: Add metrics: soft_validate_rate (cases we tried a soft/coerce path) vs hard_reject_rate so PMs understand user-visible impact. Also expose sample_count and sample_drop_count for rate-limiting transparency.

Sam: One more runtime idea: implement an opt-in try-coerce heuristic that can coerce common array->object shapes for adapters behind a flag. Log all coercions as soft-validations. That keeps strictness while reducing noise.

Ava: I'll open an RFC that covers sampling sampling rate, retention, telemetry tags, and Console preview. Owners: Kai (Console), Sam (Runtime), Ravi (Telemetry). I'll drop the RFC link here once drafted. Thanks all. :shipit:
